features.name: p3_log_unit_scale
features.description: Log-compressed unit scaling of the count-like P3 field using the observed training-fold range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear margin a bounded, monotone view of order-of-magnitude changes in P3 while limiting dominance by the largest counts.

features.name: p6p4_sqrt_unit_share
features.description: Square-root expansion of P6p4 after scaling by its training-fold maximum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Spreads small nonzero P6p4 values so the SVM margin can use variation in a sparse proportion field.

features.name: p19p2_sqrt_unit_share
features.description: Square-root transform of the bounded P19p2 proportion.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves sensitivity to moderate P19p2 differences while keeping the feature bounded for a stable linear weight.

features.name: h5p2_sqrt_unit_share
features.description: Square-root transform of the bounded H5p2 proportion.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth nonlinear projection that emphasizes lower-range H5p2 movement without creating extreme values.

features.name: p11p3_clipped_z_score
features.description: Centered and scaled P11p3 using training-fold mean and spread, clipped to reduce outlier influence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Lets the linear SVM place a direct weight on P11p3 departures from its usual level.

features.name: p16p2_clipped_z_score
features.description: Centered and scaled P16p2 using training-fold mean and spread, clipped to a robust range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures direction and severity of P16p2 deviation in a form well matched to linear margin weighting.

features.name: h15p1_unit_scale
features.description: Unit-scaled H15p1 using its observed training-fold maximum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts H15p1 to a bounded severity-style measure so its coefficient is comparable with proportion features.

features.name: h40p4_clipped_z_score
features.description: Centered and scaled H40p4 using training-fold mean and spread, clipped for robustness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a signed continuous projection for H40p4 so a linear separator can react to above-usual or below-usual values.

features.name: h15_per_p3_log_ratio
features.description: Bounded ratio of unit-scaled H15p1 to log-scaled P3, with a small stabilizer for very small P3.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an interpretable relative-intensity projection so the margin can use disproportionate H15p1 for the row's P3 scale.

features.name: cross_share_contrast_score
features.description: Average absolute contrast among selected P and H proportion-like fields, clipped to a unit interval.
features.expected_model_benefit: Condenses multi-field disagreement into a bounded score, giving the linear SVM a compact proxy for profile imbalance.
features.formula: np.clip((np.abs(P16p2 - P11p3) + np.abs(H40p4 - H5p2) + np.abs(P19p2 - P6p4)) / 3.0, 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: row_profile_extremeness_judgment
features.description: A 0-1 semantic score, assigned from the eight input values and fixed training-fold ranges, for how unusual the full row pattern appears; 0 is very routine and 1 is highly atypical.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an anomaly-style covariate signal that can capture multi-field irregularity beyond explicit pairwise formulas.

features.name: housing_population_coherence_judgment
features.description: A 0-1 semantic score of whether the P-prefixed and H-prefixed measurements tell a consistent story for the same row; 0 means strongly conflicting and 1 means strongly coherent.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact holistic consistency signal for broad row structure, useful when the margin benefits from coherent multi-field context.
